title: Young Toddler Kissing Baby in Stroller, 1960s Outdoor B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sweet black-and-white mid-century snapshot captures a tender moment outdoors as a young toddler wearing checkered sun-suit overalls gently leans over to kiss a baby resting in a vintage metal-frame stroller. The toddler holds a toy kaleidoscope while standing on a sunny, gravelly garden patch beside a bench.
